Броксуридин C9H11BrN2O5 = 307.1. CAS — 59-14-3. Profile Broxuridine is a thymidine analogue which acts as a radiosensi- tiser to enhance the effects of radiotherapy. It is also reported to possess antiviral activity. A related compound brivudine (p.867) is used as an antiviral. Broxuridine has been given by intra-arterial infusion, with radi- otherapy and other antineoplastic agents, in the treatment of tu- mours of the brain, head, and neck. It has also been used diagnos- tically. ◊ References. 1. Freese A, et al. The application of 5-bromodeoxyuridine in the management of CNS tumors. J Neurooncol 1994; 20: 81–95. 2. Phillips TL, et al.
